observations.statement: GameDistribution's developer agreement requires implementing its SDK before upload, or publishing is denied.
observations.excerpt: 2.6.3 before uploading the Games, implement the SDK in the Games as instructed by the Distributor; failure to do this will result in a denied request for publishing;

observations.statement: GameDistribution's developer agreement entitles the developer to a 33% share of Net Revenue.
observations.excerpt: the Developer is entitled to a revenue share of 33% (thirty three percent) of the Net Revenue

observations.statement: GameDistribution serves advertisements within games through its SDK.
observations.excerpt: Distributor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to serve the advertisements within the Games through use of the SDK

observations.statement: GameDistribution pays the developer revenue share within 60 days after the monthly report becomes available.
observations.excerpt: Within 60 days after the report for the preceding calendar month becoming available, the Distributor will pay the Developer Revenue Share
